name: Mantle Of Disorder
body:
School evocation [lawful]; Level antipaladin 3, paladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range self
Area 30-foot-radius centered on you
Duration 1 round/level

You radiate an aura of power out to a radius of 30 feet, granting your allies additional power to combat chaos.

While in the aura’s radius, whenever an ally (including yourself) misses on an attack roll against a chaotic-aligned enemy within the range of the aura, the next attack roll they make against that enemy gains a +2 sacred (or profane, if the ally is evil). While this spell lasts, against any given enemy, this bonus is cumulative with itself if the ally consecutively misses hitting that enemy. Once the ally has succeeded in hitting an enemy, the bonus from this spell is reset to 0 against that enemy.

If the enemy is a chaotic-aligned fey or outsider or if they have the chaos subtype, the bonus provided by mantle of order is increased to +4 instead.
